newsitem.title: USA: Cadiz Land stake lifted by FMR group.
newsitem.headline: Cadiz Land stake lifted by FMR group.

text.p: A group led by FMR Corp said Tuesday it raised its stake in Cadiz Land Co Inc to 11.37 percent or 2,522,667 common shares from 8.74 percent previously held.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include the purchase of 969,357 common shares between December 18 and December 19 at prices ranging from $3.875 to $4.110 per share.
FMR Corp is the parent of the investment adviser to Fidelity Funds.
Cadiz Land is an agricultural land development company based in Rancho Cucamonga, Calif.
